Privacy policy

How we handle your information.

Who we are

PolyGolf is a browser game made by Room310 × OneShotStudios, available at polygolf.lol. For privacy requests, contact the team at room310support@gmail.com. Last updated: October 4, 2026.

What we collect

Guest progress and settings are saved in your browser. If you create an account, we store your username, authentication information, saved progress, inventory, trade offers and exchange history, match results and account activity. Supabase manages password authentication; your password is not shown in your public profile. Optional information includes your uploaded profile picture, biography, friend connections, and community maps and likes. Hosting and backend services may also process IP addresses, request timestamps and technical logs to operate and protect the service.

How we use it

We use this information to sign you in, save progress, deliver multiplayer and competitive matches, display profiles and rankings, publish community maps, prevent cheating and abuse, and respond to support requests. We do not sell personal information. Our hosting provider may collect technical performance measurements to help operate the site.

What other players see

Your username, profile picture, biography, equipped nameplate, public statistics, rankings and published maps can be shown to other players. Match participants see gameplay status and results. Accepted friends can see your eligible trading inventory, including item patterns; participants can see their trade offers and exchange history. Do not put private contact details or sensitive information in public names, photos, biographies or maps.

Service providers and storage

Netlify hosts the website; Supabase provides authentication, database and server functions. Google Fonts delivers the website fonts and may receive connection information when your browser requests them. Providers may process information in countries outside your own. Browser storage holds local progress, preferences and sign-in tokens. Sign-in tokens persist between visits until you sign out, clear storage, or the authentication provider invalidates them. Clearing it removes guest progress and may sign you out. The current game does not offer real-money checkout or collect payment-card details.

Cookies and local storage

Read our cookies and browser storage policy for saved progress, sign-in tokens, preferences and controls.

Browser assistants

If your browser supports an assistant integration, the game exposes tools to read your local game status and open menu screens. These tools do not provide your password. Use your browser’s assistant settings to control whether an assistant can access the page.

Retention and your choices

We retain account data while needed to provide the game, address support issues, and protect against abuse. You can edit your photo and biography in your profile. For access, correction, export or account deletion, email room310support@gmail.com with your username and the request. We may need to verify account ownership. Do not send your password. Deleted data may remain temporarily in provider backups or limited security records. Rights and exceptions depend on where you live; we will handle requests in accordance with applicable law.

Children

Accounts and online community features are intended for players aged 13 and older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has supplied information, contact room310support@gmail.com so we can investigate and take appropriate action. A school’s mention in the credits does not make this an official school service.

Security and changes

We use provider authentication and access controls, but no online service can guarantee absolute security. Keep your password private and sign out on shared devices. We may update this policy as the game changes and will post the revised date here.

Community links and rewards

We store which community rewards you have claimed. We do not connect to or verify your social accounts. Instagram, X, YouTube and Discord are external services with their own privacy policies.
